page_title: Stik: Free Quick-Capture Markdown Notes for Mac

summary.name: Stik
summary.one_liner: Stik is a free, open-source macOS quick-capture app that opens a floating post-it with a keyboard shortcut and saves each note as a plain markdown file.
keywords: note capture shortcut cmd shift s
use_cases: take quick notes without opening a big app
keep local markdown notes on a Mac
share note folders with a team via git
sync notes across Macs with iCloud Drive
summary.what_it_does: Pressing ⌘⇧S from anywhere on macOS opens a floating post-it for typing a thought; pressing Escape saves it and returns to work. Notes are stored as plain .md files in ~/Documents/Stik/ with no account, cloud, or sync setup required. It is built with Tauri and Rust. On-device AI provides semantic search and smart folder suggestions, and the page says note content is not sent to an AI service.
notable: Plain markdown files in ~/Documents/Stik/ with no database lock-in
Global ⌘⇧S shortcut opens a floating capture note
On-device AI for semantic search and folder suggestions without sending content to an AI service
Team sharing via git and sync via iCloud Drive
caveats: macOS only; no other platforms are named on the page
